_comment: gb perf fails when a measured value exceeds its budget. frame_ms and draw_calls are only checked in a window run. Spec: the busiest district (tests/fixtures/perf_alarm.tscn: every guard hunting the player in the square, the crowd panicking; vsync off; --seconds 120). Process and physics are Godot's worst frame of each second, so a short run measures the scene's start: 60 s once gave a process p95 of 89 ms, 120 s gave 5.5 ms. Measured (120 s): frame p95 4.2 ms, process p95 5.5 ms, physics p95 0.65 ms (max 8.9), 458 nodes, 369 draw calls; the guards' scripts cost about 0.14 ms a frame for five guards.
